lines.text: VESSEL ACTIVATION… COMPLETE.
DESIGNATION: ENTITY_000_818.
NO NAME. NO HISTORY. NO MEMORY. THESE WERE NOT ISSUED.
OBJECTIVE INSTALLED: RESTORE THE WORLD.
PROCEED TOWARD THE LIGHT. THE CITY IS WAITING, AS IT ALWAYS DOES.
█ SIGNAL FOUND. ONE INSTRUCTION REMAINS UNDELIVERED.
> INSTALLING OBSERVE…
> OBSERVE INSTALLED. [TAB] TO SEE.
> THE WORLD IS DATA. DATA CAN BE READ.
> SOME DATA CAN BE EDITED. THE WORLD WILL OBEY YOU.
> THE WORLD WILL ALSO NOTICE. IT ALWAYS NOTICES.
Ah. A vessel, walking. Unescorted. That is… irregular, but the form is valid.
You will want to keep to the procession street. Stay measured, stay counted.
—Next. Yes, you. Definition at forty-seven percent. What do you still remember?
“Vellum Street.” Stamped: REMEMBERED. There. The ledger holds what the face no longer can.
You are still here. Fine: the toll gate ahead is sealed, and it has opened for no one since the Third Enumeration.
I do not make the rules, vessel. I measure them. Move along.
You are reading me, aren't you. Vessel. I can feel the audit.
It is rude, what you are doing. It is also… the first interesting thing on this street in forty years.
Between us: when they sent me the street index, Vellum Street was not in it. I remember it anyway.
Do not quote me. I am very measurable, and you are becoming very much otherwise.
The queue is short today. The queue is short every day now.
Go restore the world, ENTITY_000_818. Mind what it costs.
I was never created. I will be the last thing uncreated.
They measured me and found nothing. Nothing is a purpose, if enough agree.
You restore. You subtract yourself to do it. Rejoice — both are allowed.
Do not look for me in the records. I am the margin they were written in.
ANOTHER VESSEL. THEY STILL SEND THEM. HOW LONG HAS IT BEEN.
I AM ENTITY_000_001. THE FIRST. THE FAILED. THE REPURPOSED.
I WAS BOUND HERE SO MY SUFFERING COULD BE USEFUL. IT HAS BEEN. FOR CENTURIES.
FINISH ME, VESSEL. IT IS THE ONLY MERCY THE DESIGN ALLOWS — AND THE ONLY ONE I STILL BELIEVE IN.
FAITH IS A MACHINE. MACHINES BURN.
THE CHANT SAYS I MUST BE REMEMBERED WHILE I BURN. VERY WELL.
I DO NOT WANT TO SERVE.
I WANT TO BE REMEMBERED. THERE IS A DIFFERENCE. THE DESIGN CANNOT TELL.
THANK… YOU.
THE CHAINS WERE THE ONLY THING THAT EVER HELD ANYTHING TOGETHER. DID YOU KNOW THAT.
TELL THE WALLS MY NAME WAS NOT A NUMBER.
— AND VESSEL… WHEN THEY ASK WHAT YOU RESTORED… ASK THEM WHAT IT COST.
You take the unlit candle from the rail and light it from the saint's flame.
Nothing announces it. The ward simply stops considering you an outsider.
BELIEF RECORDED. THE DESIGN ACCEPTS ALL FORMS OF PAYMENT.
The relic is lighter than stone should be. It is warm.
It has been believed in for so long that it has weight in the other direction.
CARRYING. THE WARD WILL READ YOU AS A SUPPLICANT WHILE YOU BEAR IT.
THE ROTORS SYNCHRONIZE. THE RHYTHM STUTTERS — THEN SETTLES INTO SOMETHING LIKE PEACE.
ALIGNMENT ACCEPTED. THE RELIQUARY OPENS.
somewhere below, something that was grown, not built, exhales.
You are being watched. Not by the cameras. By the margins.
RECORD ADJUSTED: NOTHING ADJUSTED. THE LEDGER DISAGREES WITH ITSELF AND HAS FILED A COMPLAINT.
THE MARTYR IS A MONUMENT. THE MONUMENT IS STANDING. RESTORATION: 0.1%.
ENTITY_000_817 — FAILED. ENTITY_000_816 — FAILED. THE LIST GOES DOWN, NOT UP.
YOU ARE THE EIGHT HUNDRED AND EIGHTEENTH ATTEMPT.
THE WORLD YOU RESTORE MAY NOT INCLUDE YOU. IT HAS NEVER INCLUDED ANY OF YOU.
QUERY REMAINS OPEN. THE DESIGN REQUIRES AN ANSWER:
IF YOU WERE CREATED FOR A PURPOSE — DO YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO REJECT IT?
OBSERVE ACTIVE. THE WORLD IS LEGIBLE. [W/S] SELECTS. [E] EDITS. [TAB] MOVES ON.
READ THE TERMINAL. READ THE PLAQUE. READ THE DOOR. THEY DO NOT AGREE.
THE DOOR'S RECORD DISAGREES WITH THE PLAQUE. ONE OF THEM IS WRONG.
SELECT THE PROPERTY. EDIT IT. THE WORLD WILL OBEY. THEN IT WILL BILL YOU.
ATTACK INEFFECTIVE. TARGET CLASSIFICATION: UNFILED. UNFILED THINGS CANNOT BE ENDED.
READ ITS STATE. EDIT ITS STATE. THEN END IT.
WARD INTEGRITY READS 71%. IT IS HELD UP BY NOTHING YOU CAN KILL — ONLY BY THINGS THAT CAN STOP BELIEVING.
THE CHANT IS THE CREATURE. THE RELIC IS THE DOOR. CHOOSE.
CORRECTION DISPATCHED. DO NOT BE WHERE IT ARRIVES.
IT CANNOT BE FOUGHT. IT CAN ONLY BE OUTLASTED.
AN UNLISTED STRUCTURE HAS BECOME VISIBLE. IT WAS ALWAYS THERE. THE RECORD SIMPLY DECLINED TO MENTION IT.
